purpose: Implement and prepare, without training, one immutable actor-only two-stage PPO bootstrap from the original iteration-004 checkpoint. This plan does not authorize training, games, packaging, promotion, or submission.
selected_hypothesis: The zero-initialized final residual actor layer blocks upstream actor gradients on the first update. Opening only that layer in stage 1, then continuing the same Adam state with an actor-only stage 2, will let the existing state and action encoders separate return-positive from return-negative sampled actions by public context instead of moving an entire action family in one direction.

source_implementation.snapshot_definition: Enumerate regular files recursively, excluding every path with a __pycache__ or test_outputs component and every .pyc suffix. Sort by the unsigned UTF-8 bytes of each relative POSIX path in ascending lexicographic order. Hash the concatenation, for each file, of relative_path UTF-8 bytes, NUL, decimal byte_size ASCII, NUL, uppercase_file_sha256 ASCII, and LF.

required_capabilities: prepare a canonical no-training receipt without constructing an optimizer or writing a checkpoint
validate the immutable plan, parent rejection, initial checkpoint, manifest, dataset, v4 probe, source implementation, runtime, and exact action-family memberships
validate a separately hashed exact execution spec before constructing the optimizer
perform exactly two full-batch actor-only optimizer steps over the same 830 manifest-order rows
retain one Adam object and state across both stages
record stage-1 and stage-2 probabilities, values, KL, TV, parameter changes, optimizer state, gradients, losses, and every gate
publish one final checkpoint and one canonical accepted or rejected receipt without overwriting any input

training_contract.advantage_source: Compute GAE once from the immutable initial checkpoint and dataset, convert and normalize in the pinned trainer float32 domain, then hold every advantage and value target fixed across both stages.
training_contract.behavior_ratio_source: Use the immutable stored behavior log-probability for both stages.

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.parameter_universe: all state_encoder, action_encoder, and residual_head parameters; value_head is excluded

sampled_action_family_contract.family_definition: For each PPO row, use legal_semantic_options[sampled_index].payload.option_type from the public semantic action surface. Every pinned row has exactly one sampled index.
sampled_action_family_contract.row_map_definition: Uppercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON with schema_version sampled-option-type-row-map-v1 and rows in ppo_row_ordinal order. Each row contains ppo_row_ordinal, sampled_index, integer option_type, semantic_identity, and trainer_normalized_advantage_float32.
sampled_action_family_contract.membership_hash_definition: Uppercase SHA-256 of canonical JSON containing schema_version sampled-option-type-membership-v1, integer option_type, and sorted ppo_row_ordinals.
sampled_action_family_contract.qualifying_rule: Freeze families having at least five trainer-normalized-positive and five trainer-normalized-negative sampled rows in the initial 830-row dataset. Never reselect after an update.

gate_definition.probability_domain: CPU float32 policy probabilities converted exactly to Python float before subtraction
gate_definition.initial_probability: p0_i from the immutable initial checkpoint
gate_definition.neutral: -tau <= g <= tau; exact boundaries are neutral and fail a strict median gate
gate_definition.lower_empirical_median: Sort ascending and select index (n - 1) // 2 without averaging.
gate_definition.per_family_stage_gate: For each of the six qualifying families, split the frozen rows by positive and negative normalized advantage. At both stage 1 and stage 2, the lower empirical median g in all 12 groups must be strictly greater than tau.
gate_definition.global_alignment_score: S_stage = (aligned_count - anti_aligned_count) / 830; neutral rows contribute zero and every row is counted once.
gate_definition.global_lower_median: M_stage is the lower empirical median g across all 830 rows.

global_stage_gates.stage_1_hard_stop: A stage-1 nonfinite value or breach of any global KL/TV bound rejects and stops before stage 2. Directional and family gates are recorded but do not stop stage 2.
final_acceptance: exactly two optimizer steps completed without rollback or early stop
stage-1 and stage-2 parameter and optimizer-state contracts pass
all inherited directional gates pass at stage 2
all family gates pass at both stages
both stage-2 global improvement inequalities pass
checkpoint provenance and post-save reload validation pass

prepare_receipt_must_bind: plan, parent result, input, probe, source implementation, dataset, runtime, and thread hashes
all 830 ordered row identities, initial probabilities, fixed advantages, sampled indices, semantic identities, option types, and family memberships
the exact 7 family memberships, six qualifying families, row-map hash, counts, and gate definitions
the initial model parameter names, per-tensor byte hashes, trainability stages, and value-head baseline
proof that no optimizer was constructed and no checkpoint or parameter change occurred
implementation_tests: prepare constructs no optimizer, changes no parameter, and writes no checkpoint
wrong parent rejection, rejected checkpoint use, input hash, row, family, advantage, plan, implementation, runtime, or execution spec fails before optimizer construction
stage 1 changes exactly the final residual layer and creates optimizer state only for its two tensors
stage 2 uses the same Adam object, changes exactly all ten actor tensors, leaves every value-head tensor byte-exact, and has the exact per-parameter step states
advantages and behavior log-probabilities are identical across stages and remain bound to the initial checkpoint
family lower-median, deadband boundaries, global score, global median, and stage-improvement gates are tested at and beyond every boundary
all inherited END and global KL/TV gates remain enforced
stage distributions, values, losses, gradients, parameter diffs, and checkpoint reload evidence are complete and canonical
input files, existing outputs, rejected iteration-005 artifacts, and source implementation are never overwritten
race-safe Windows publication properties from iteration 005 remain intact
forbidden_changes: loading or continuing from the iteration-005 rejected checkpoint
teacher-action imitation, behavior cloning, Gold-action labels, or replay-derived opponent-policy labels
END-specific loss, mask, penalty, reward, duplication, reweighting, or hand-coded protection
changes to reward, dataset, row order, advantage values, behavior log-probabilities, model architecture, encoder features, teacher, deck, opponent population, or behavior formula
constructing a second optimizer or resetting Adam state between stages
using changed value outputs to recompute advantages or claim critic improvement
same-iteration retry, games, runtime smoke, packaging, promotion, or Kaggle submission
execution_stop_rule: Implementation and a no-training prepare receipt must pass independent code and numerical provenance audits before a separate immutable execution spec is authored. The plan itself runs no optimizer step and no game.
